verdict.rationale: Fivetran's evidence shows it builds a 'unified context layer' for external AI tools (fivetran-docs-7) and offers an AI support assistant for troubleshooting tickets (fivetran-docs-44), plus an MCP server for querying sync status (fivetran-docs-28/60), but none of this is AI-generated insight or suggestions about the user's actual data content surfaced inside the product itself.
